title: [Master]-Validation of the "No." field on the sales order additionally re-validates the Unit of Measure Code
summary: Validation of the item number field on sales lines now prevents duplicate production order status checks when the unit of measure code is re-validated, fixing repeated modal dialogs and write-transaction errors.
key_points: Added StatusCheckSuspended flag to suppress nested production order status checks during item number validation
Wrapped unit of measure code validation to prevent redundant status checks triggered by quantity and shipment date updates
Modified CheckProdOrderStatus codeunit to respect the suspended check flag
Changes applied across all localization layers and base application
Includes test coverage for the fix
quote: Wrapped Validate("Unit of Measure Code") inside ValidateUnitOfMeasureCodeFromNo() with StatusCheckSuspended to suppress nested status checks
